purpose: The one primary action of a screen that floats above its content, such as create, compose or add. A leading icon with an optional label on a surface that lifts.

notFor.case: An action that sits inside a row of other actions.
Several floating actions that share one entry point.
An icon-only action in a toolbar or table row.

Default.visual: solid takes Action/primary/default with Content/on-action (brand) or Action/secondary/default with Content/on-secondary (neutral); soft takes Surface/layer-2 or Surface/accent with Content/primary or Content/accent; inverse takes Surface/inverse with Content/inverse. Elevation/highlight on top.

Hover.visual: Solid fills move to Action/primary/hover or Action/secondary/hover; soft and inverse gain an overlay (Action/ghost/hover, Surface/selected, Surface/inverse-muted); the elevation rises.

Pressed.visual: Solid fills move to Action/primary/pressed or Action/secondary/pressed; soft and inverse take Action/ghost/pressed, Surface/selected-pressed or Surface/inverse-muted; the elevation settles.

Focused.visual: A 2px halo outside the button (Border/ring/default, Border/subtle or Surface/inverse-muted); the elevation stays.

Disabled.visual: Surface/page under an Action/disabled/default overlay, Content/disabled ink, no lift.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space activates it (native button).
notes: With a label, the label is the accessible name; an icon-only FAB needs an aria-label.
The contract lists no motion roles even though the elevation changes on hover and press.

openQuestions: Motion: the lift rises on hover and settles on press, but the contract declares no motion role. Which role moves it, and what happens with reduced motion?
Placement: where does the FAB float (corner, offset from the edge, above a bottom bar)? Nothing in the contract fixes it.
